BTS Group Pays Respects to the Royal Remains of Her Royal Highness Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradebyavati Kromluangrajasarinisiribajra Mahavajrarajadhita

Back 22 July 2026

On 20 July 2026, BTS Group, led by Mr. Keeree Kanjanapas, Chairman, and Mr. Kavin Kanjanapas, Executive Director and CEO, together with the Board of Directors and executives, paid their respects to the Royal Remains of Her Royal Highness Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradebyavati Kromluangrajasarinisiribajra Mahavajrarajadhita and presented a floral tribute before Her Royal Highness’s portrait at Phiman Rattaya Throne Hall, the Grand Palace.

Her Royal Highness Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradebyavati demonstrated exemplary conduct and unwavering dedication to the pursuit of knowledge, while undertaking numerous royal duties for the well-being of the people and the nation. Her Royal Highness made significant contributions in various fields, including education, law, international affairs, military affairs, and public welfare, making invaluable contributions to the advancement of society and the nation.

In profound appreciation of Her Royal Highness’s immeasurable grace and benevolence, BTS Group humbly draws inspiration from Her Royal Highness’s compassion, dedication, and commitment to serving the nation and its people as guiding principles for conducting its business with responsibility, transparency, and a steadfast commitment to creating sustainable value for society. BTS Group remains committed to developing infrastructure, mass transit systems, and services that contribute to enhancing the quality of life of the people, while continuously supporting charitable initiatives and environmental sustainability.

BTS Group remains steadfast in its loyalty to the Monarchy and is committed to drawing inspiration from Her Royal Highness’s royal aspirations and exemplary dedication to serving the public good. These principles will continue to inspire and drive the organisation towards stable and sustainable growth, contributing to the enduring benefit of the nation, society and the people.
